newsitem.title: LEBANON: One Israeli killed, seven wounded in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: One Israeli killed, seven wounded in Lebanon.

text.p: One Israeli soldier was killed and four wounded on Wednesday in a clash with guerrillas in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

Five soldiers were wounded in the clash in Shoumariyeh area but one of them died later suffering from his wounds, the South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia sources said. Hours earlier three soldiers were wounded in mine blast in the zone, they said.
